subject: Private deployment networking readiness & on-prem package coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.k@hemisphere.ai>, NetOps <netops@hemisphere.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment networking readiness & on-prem package coordination

Hi Samir / NetOps team —

Thanks again for committing to Redwood Private for Hemisphere's inference workload. We're starting handoffs from CS to Implementation this week and want to lock down the networking / on-prem package items so your infra team can schedule the install window.

Summary of what we need to confirm before kickoff:
- VPC peering architecture and CIDR allowlist (Hemisphere -> Redwood managed endpoints)
- Private endpoints (TLS cert expectations, mTLS vs. token-based auth)
- On-prem package footprint (GPU node counts, 2U appliance vs. VM image)
- Service account and KMS key workflows (who will provision, rotation cadence)
- A short preflight checklist for your SRE team to run during staging (I attached an initial draft)

Attached: hemisphere-network-diagram-v1.pdf, onprem-install-checklist.xlsx, redwood-private-packages-2028-01.zip

Are you available for a 45-minute run-through on Thursday (1/12) at 10:00am PT? If that works we'll invite the engineers and get a shared doc for action items.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Khatri <samir.k@hemisphere.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: NetOps <netops@hemisphere.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment networking readiness & on-prem package coordination

Jordan — thanks for the clear checklist. Thursday 1/12 10:00am PT works for our lead engineer (Rosa) and myself. Quick notes after a first pass through the attachments: 

- CIDR / peering: Hemisphere will carve a /20 for Redwood peering and NAT egress will be via our transit gateway. Can you confirm Redwood's expected source IP set for health checks and control-plane traffic?
- TLS / mTLS: We prefer mutual TLS for control-plane connections. We'll need Redwood to provide a client cert bundle or a documented cert rotation process.
- On-prem package: the appliance zip looks fine; we'll provision 3 GPU nodes initially (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) and one management node. Need a sizing doc from you that maps service tiers to CPU/GPU/ram/storage.
- KMS: We use AWS KMS in our account; we'll need an integration guide for customer-managed keys (CMK) to put in the preflight.

I'll add these to the shared drive doc before Thursday. Attaching a short internal note (we trimmed some firewall rules) — will bring details to the call.

Samir

--
Samir Khatri
Head of Infrastructure | Hemisphere AI
samir.k@hemisphere.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.k@hemisphere.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: NetOps <netops@hemisphere.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 10:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment networking readiness & on-prem package coordination

Thanks everyone — good call earlier. Notes / action items from today's run-through (short bullets so ops can triage):

- Jordan to send explicit IP ranges for control-plane and health-check endpoints by EOD 1/12 (ACTION: Jordan)
- Redwood will publish an mTLS onboarding guide and provide a short-lived cert bundle for initial validation (ACTION: Evelyn)
- Hemisphere to commit a /20 for peering and confirm route table names and TGW IDs (ACTION: Samir)
- Hemisphere SRE to provision 3 GPU worker nodes + 1 management node in staging and run preflight checklist (ACTION: NetOps)
- Exchange of CMK ARNs for KMS integration (ACTION: Samir + Monica)

Attachments uploaded to shared drive: hem-network-call-notes-20280112.md (link sent in calendar invite). Please flag anything missing here. We'll aim to complete the preflight by 1/19 so we can schedule on-prem package delivery the week of 1/22.

Best — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.k@hemisphere.ai>, NetOps <netops@hemisphere.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jan 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment networking readiness & on-prem package coordination

Hi Samir — attaching the mTLS onboarding guide and the initial cert bundle for staging validation (see attached filenames). A couple implementation notes: 

1) Cert bundle is time-limited to 7 days for initial handshakes; please validate and let us know if you need a CA chain in a different format.
2) Control-plane originates from three IPs in us-west-2; I'll share the exact list as a small CSV in the Drive link.
3) For CMK: Redwood supports a cross-account grant workflow; Samir, please send your CMK ARN and we will initiate the grant and test encrypt/decrypt flows in staging.

Next steps: If Hemisphere completes the staging preflight by 1/19 we can confirm the shipping/fedex ETA for the on-prem appliance and lock the install window for 1/23 - 1/25.

Attaching: redwood-mtls-onboard-v1.pdf, initial-client-bundle.tar.gz

Thanks — Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
